ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle JKL, vertex K is above, J is at the lower left, and L is at the lower right. The three sides JK, KL, and JL all have the same single pink tick mark, indicating that the lengths of these three sides are equal. The left side JK is labeled 7x, the right side KL is labeled 11x - 8, and the bottom side JL is labeled x + 12. Reasoning: Because the three sides have the same tick mark, JK = JL = KL. According to the method, first use JK = JL: 7x = x + 12. Solving gives 6x = 12, so x = 2. Then substitute into KL = 11x - 8, obtaining KL = 11(2) - 8 = 22 - 8 = 14.
